extracted.stage: Divorce financial proceedings, next hearing listed at the Family Court at Birmingham
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Iqbal & Co seeks an £18,500 litigation loan for the applicant in a divorce with around £83,000 of assets in dispute, ahead of a hearing on 21 December at the Family Court at Birmingham.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of the applicant; we have logged the details you provided, including the £18,500 requested and the hearing listed for 21 December at the Family Court at Birmingham. To progress matters we will need confirmation of your client's identity and address, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, and documentary evidence of the assets in dispute, including the property and pension valuations. It would also help to have a brief chronology of the proceedings and details of any existing charges or borrowing against those assets. We will send our criteria and application form separately. A member of our team will review the enquiry and come back to you once the above has been received.
